metadata.purpose: Explain how students obtain missing documents required by scholarship applications.
metadata.scope: National processes where a national authority exists, plus Maharashtra state-certificate workflows as a concrete verified state implementation.
metadata.important_rule: Obtaining a document may allow eligibility verification or application readiness; it does not by itself make the student eligible.
metadata.source_policy: Use official government/provider acquisition processes wherever available. Institution/board-specific processes are marked general rather than invented as official national workflows.

application_steps.action: Register on Aaple Sarkar.
application_steps.details: Create a user ID/password using Aadhaar verification or mobile OTP profile registration.

application_steps.action: Open Revenue Department services.
application_steps.details: Choose Revenue Services.

application_steps.action: Select Income Certificate.
application_steps.details: Review the service-specific document checklist.

application_steps.action: Fill income and family details.
application_steps.details: Enter income year, applicant/address details, family/farm/other-source income and beneficiary information.

application_steps.action: Upload supporting documents.
application_steps.details: Attach the required proofs shown by the portal.

application_steps.action: Accept declaration and submit.
application_steps.details: Complete the application and pay the applicable service fee.

application_steps.action: Track application.
application_steps.details: Use the Aaple Sarkar application ID to follow status and respond to rectification requests if raised.

application_steps.action: Download/verify certificate when issued.
application_steps.details: Use the authenticated-certificate verification feature where available.

supporting_documents: Other documents requested by the portal based on applicant case
document_acquisition_guides.processing_time: 15 days under Maharashtra notified Right to Service timeline
document_acquisition_guides.notes: Scholarship-specific acceptable financial year/issuer still comes from that scholarship's rule set.

application_steps.action: Register/login on Aaple Sarkar.
application_steps.details: Use OTP/Aadhaar-based profile registration.

application_steps.action: Open Revenue Department services.
application_steps.details: Choose Age, Nationality and Domicile Certificate.

application_steps.action: Review identity/address/residence evidence requirements.
application_steps.details: The portal shows acceptable proofs for the selected service.

application_steps.action: Fill applicant and residence details.
application_steps.details: Enter personal/address/residence-history information accurately.

application_steps.action: Upload required evidence and submit.
application_steps.details: Attach accepted documents and complete the service application.

application_steps.action: Track by application ID.
application_steps.details: Respond to any rectification request if raised.

application_steps.action: Receive and verify the authenticated certificate.
application_steps.details: Use the certificate verification feature where available.

supporting_documents: Residence/domicile supporting records as requested by portal
document_acquisition_guides.processing_time: 15 days under Maharashtra notified Right to Service timeline
document_acquisition_guides.notes: Only use where the scholarship actually requires domicile/residence evidence.

application_steps.action: Open Aaple Sarkar caste-certificate service.
application_steps.details: Review the service-specific document checklist.

application_steps.action: Prepare at least one accepted identity proof.
application_steps.details: Examples on the official checklist include PAN, Passport, MNREGA Job Card, Driving Licence, applicant photo, or government/semi-government ID.

application_steps.action: Prepare at least one accepted address proof.
application_steps.details: Examples include Passport, water bill, ration card, Aadhaar, voter ID, telephone/electricity bill, driving licence, property-tax receipt, 7/12/8A extract or rent receipt.

application_steps.action: Prepare caste-supporting/other records.
application_steps.details: Upload documents requested by the service based on family/community evidence.

application_steps.action: Submit the application through the prescribed Aaple Sarkar/service-centre process.
application_steps.details: Follow portal instructions and keep the application ID.

application_steps.action: Track status and answer rectification requests.
application_steps.details: Use the application tracking function.

application_steps.action: Verify the issued authenticated certificate.
application_steps.details: Use the 18-digit barcode verification function when available.

supporting_documents: At least one approved identity proof
At least one approved address proof
Affidavit or other documents where required
document_acquisition_guides.processing_time: 21 days under Maharashtra notified Right to Service timeline
document_acquisition_guides.notes: OBC-NCL may require a separate Non-Creamy Layer certificate in addition to caste certificate.

application_steps.action: Register/login on Aaple Sarkar.
application_steps.details: Use your citizen profile.

application_steps.action: Select Non-Creamy Layer Certificate under Revenue Department services.
application_steps.details: Review current service documents and eligibility.

application_steps.action: Provide caste/category and family-income information.
application_steps.details: Enter required family and income details.

application_steps.action: Upload caste, identity, address and income-related proofs as requested.
application_steps.details: Use the current portal checklist.

application_steps.action: Submit and track the application.
application_steps.details: Respond to any rectification request from the revenue authority.

application_steps.action: Download/collect the certificate after approval.
application_steps.details: Verify authenticity where the portal supports it.

document_acquisition_guides.processing_time: 21 days under Maharashtra notified Right to Service timeline
document_acquisition_guides.notes: Exact supporting-document list should be taken from the live Aaple Sarkar service page when applying.

document_acquisition_guides.issuing_authority: Competent Medical Authority notified by State/UT under DEPwD UDID system

application_steps.action: Apply online for UDID / Disability Certificate.
application_steps.details: Complete and submit the application on the UDID portal.

application_steps.action: Visit the selected Hospital/CMO office after status shows Submitted.
application_steps.details: Go to the UDID/Disability Certification Section chosen in the application.

application_steps.action: Get the application verified.
application_steps.details: The hospital/medical authority verifies the application and may request corrections.

application_steps.action: Attend specialist assessment.
application_steps.details: Assigned specialist doctor(s) assess the disability and prepare a report.

application_steps.action: Medical Board review.
application_steps.details: The board determines disability type and percentage and validates the certificate.

application_steps.action: UDID and disability certificate are generated.
application_steps.details: The competent medical authority generates both after approval.

application_steps.action: Receive UDID card.
application_steps.details: DEPwD dispatches the card to the registered address by Speed Post.

application_steps.action: Give data-sharing consent when required for scholarships.
application_steps.details: Use PwD Dashboard consent to allow concerned government agencies/NSP to access UDID data.

supporting_documents: Aadhaar number for applicants where mandated
Medical/identity/address information requested by UDID portal
document_acquisition_guides.notes: UDID portal also provides a 'Find Nearest Medical Authority' tool by State/UT and district.

document_acquisition_guides.issuing_authority: UIDAI / authorised Aadhaar Enrolment or Update Centre

application_steps.action: Determine whether you need enrolment or an update.
application_steps.details: Existing holders can update supported demographic details; new applicants use enrolment.

application_steps.action: For online address update, login to myAadhaar.
application_steps.details: A registered mobile number is needed for OTP-based online services.

application_steps.action: Upload accepted supporting proof for the requested field.
application_steps.details: UIDAI publishes the current list of acceptable documents.

application_steps.action: For other demographic/biometric updates, visit an Aadhaar Enrolment/Update Centre.
application_steps.details: An operator captures the request and verifies documentary evidence where required.

application_steps.action: Collect acknowledgement number.
application_steps.details: Online/centre updates generate a request/enrolment number for tracking.

application_steps.action: Track the update request.
application_steps.details: Use UIDAI services to check status and download updated e-Aadhaar when available.

supporting_documents: UIDAI-accepted Proof of Identity/Address/Date of Birth documents depending on requested update
document_acquisition_guides.notes: Registered mobile is needed for many online Aadhaar services; otherwise visit an enrolment/update centre.

application_steps.action: Contact the institution's student section/registrar/administration office.
application_steps.details: Ask for a Bonafide Student Certificate for scholarship purposes.

application_steps.action: Provide student identification and enrolment details.
application_steps.details: Institution may ask for student ID, roll/enrolment number and purpose.

application_steps.action: Request scholarship-relevant fields.
application_steps.details: Ensure the certificate shows student name, institution, course/programme, year/semester and current enrolment.

application_steps.action: Collect digitally signed or stamped/signed certificate.
application_steps.details: Use the format accepted by the scholarship/application portal.

supporting_documents: Application/request form if institution uses one
document_acquisition_guides.notes: No single national issuance portal exists; exact request workflow depends on the institution.

application_steps.action: Check the institution's fee portal or accounts office.
application_steps.details: Look for paid-fee receipt/download option.

application_steps.action: Use student/enrolment credentials or provide payment details.
application_steps.details: Retrieve the receipt for the correct academic year/semester.

application_steps.action: Verify student name, institution, academic year and fee amount.
application_steps.details: The receipt should match the scholarship application data.

application_steps.action: Download or obtain an institution-authenticated copy.
application_steps.details: If the online receipt lacks authentication, request a signed/stamped version if the scholarship requires one.

application_steps.action: Use an active bank account meeting the scholarship's ownership requirements.
application_steps.details: Some schemes require the account to be in the student's own name and Aadhaar seeded.

application_steps.action: Obtain the passbook first page or account statement.
application_steps.details: It should display account holder name, account number and IFSC.

application_steps.action: If required, obtain a cancelled cheque.
application_steps.details: Some private scholarship portals accept this as an alternative.

application_steps.action: Check name and bank details against the scholarship profile.
application_steps.details: Resolve mismatches before uploading.

application_steps.action: Complete Aadhaar seeding/DBT activation where the scheme specifically requires it.
application_steps.details: Contact the bank or use supported bank/UIDAI processes.

supporting_documents: KYC documents as required by bank
document_acquisition_guides.notes: Exact bank-account type, student ownership and Aadhaar-seeding rules come from Dataset 4 scheme-specific validators.

document_acquisition_guides.document_name: Admission Letter / Seat Allotment / Admission Proof

application_steps.action: Download the admission/seat-allotment letter from the counselling or institution portal.
application_steps.details: Use the official portal for the current admission cycle.

application_steps.action: If not downloadable, request a duplicate/official admission confirmation from the institution.
application_steps.details: Contact admission/student section.

application_steps.action: Verify course, institution, admission year and student name.
application_steps.details: These fields must match the scholarship profile.

application_steps.action: Save the official PDF/copy for upload.
application_steps.details: Use the current-cycle document.

document_acquisition_guides.notes: No universal national acquisition portal exists.

application_steps.action: Use the issuing board/university/institution's result or document portal.
application_steps.details: Download the officially issued marksheet where digital access is available.

application_steps.action: For lost documents, use the issuer's duplicate-certificate/marksheet process.
application_steps.details: Requirements and fees depend on the board/university.

application_steps.action: Verify student name, examination, year and marks/CGPA.
application_steps.details: Resolve discrepancies before scholarship upload.

application_steps.action: Use DigiLocker only where the issuer's digital record is available and the scholarship accepts it.
application_steps.details: Do not assume every scholarship accepts every digital copy.

document_acquisition_guides.notes: Exact issuer process varies by education board/university.

document_acquisition_guides.issuing_authority: Local Registrar of Births and Deaths / State or local civil registration authority

application_steps.action: Identify the local civil-registration authority where the death was registered.
application_steps.details: This may be municipal corporation, municipality, panchayat or other designated registrar.

application_steps.action: Request/download the registered death certificate through the applicable state/local portal or registrar office.
application_steps.details: Use registration details and identity/relationship information as required.

application_steps.action: Check deceased name, date and cause fields where the scholarship depends on them.
application_steps.details: For Swanath COVID-19 category, the relevant official scheme requires COVID-19 to be explicitly supported.

application_steps.action: Obtain an authenticated copy if the portal/application requires one.
application_steps.details: Keep both digital and physical versions if available.

supporting_documents: Applicant/relative identity and relationship proof as required by registrar
document_acquisition_guides.notes: Civil-registration process is state/local-body specific; scholarship-specific cause-of-death requirements must be checked separately.

document_acquisition_guides.issuing_authority: Tehsildar / SDM or competent authority where applicable

application_steps.action: Check whether the target scholarship accepts an orphan certificate as an alternative to parental death certificates.
application_steps.details: Swanath explicitly provides prescribed orphan-certificate pathways.

application_steps.action: Approach the competent Tehsildar/SDM/revenue authority for the prescribed certificate.
application_steps.details: Use the format required by the scholarship/authority.

application_steps.action: Provide parental death and relationship/identity evidence requested by the authority.
application_steps.details: Requirements vary by jurisdiction.

application_steps.action: Obtain the signed/stamped certificate and verify names/relationships.
application_steps.details: Use the prescribed current format.

document_acquisition_guides.notes: The exact government issuance workflow varies by State/UT.

document_acquisition_guides.issuing_authority: Relevant Armed Forces / Central Paramilitary Forces authority

application_steps.action: Contact the relevant service/force welfare or records authority.
application_steps.details: Request official proof that the parent was martyred in action.

application_steps.action: Provide service number, deceased service member details and relationship proof.
application_steps.details: Exact evidence depends on the force/service.

application_steps.action: Obtain the official martyr/shaheed certificate or prescribed service proof.
application_steps.details: Ensure it identifies the force/service and relationship.

application_steps.action: Upload it with the scholarship application.
application_steps.details: Use it only for schemes that explicitly accept this category.

document_acquisition_guides.document_name: Worker Identity Card / Form B / Worker Registration Proof
document_acquisition_guides.issuing_authority: Applicable labour welfare organisation / employer / competent labour authority

application_steps.action: Identify the worker category required by the scholarship.
application_steps.details: Beedi, Cine, IOMC or LSDM-related categories use scheme-specific worker proof.

application_steps.action: Obtain the worker identity card, licence or Form B/register details accepted by the scheme.
application_steps.details: Use the relevant welfare/industry authority or employer records.

application_steps.action: Verify parent/guardian name and worker-category details.
application_steps.details: They must correspond to the student's relationship and scheme category.

application_steps.action: Upload the proof in NSP with the current application.
application_steps.details: Keep original/official copy for verification.
